title: Bulk File Downloader to ZIP output
description: The ZIP archive in the key-value store, a report row per input URL in the dataset, and a run summary with the direct archive link.

zip.title: ZIP archive
zip.description: Archive saved under the default name files.zip. If you set another zipFileName, use the zipUrl in the run summary.

report.title: Download report
report.description: One row per input URL with file name, size, HTTP status and error.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: OUTPUT record with zipKey, zipUrl and totals (requested, downloaded, failed, bytes).
